create_websearch_interception_logger: create a WebSearchInterceptionLogger instance with specified enabled providers and search tool name
initialize_from_proxy_config: initialize WebSearchInterceptionLogger from litellm_settings and callback_specific_params proxy config dictionaries
run_agentic_loop_websearch: run agentic loop that intercepts web search tool calls and executes litellm.asearch() for each query
short_circuit_search: short-circuit web search-only requests by executing search directly and returning synthetic Anthropic response
convert_native_websearch_tools: convert native web search tools to LiteLLM standard format before API request
